restaurants.address: 天河区育蕾二街18号东侧101铺
restaurants.desc: A light-luxury creative Cantonese bistro with a small and focused menu. The fermented olive preserved chicken with prawn paste is the house signature — combining traditional Cantonese preserving with creative plating.

dishes.en: Fermented olive chicken with prawn paste
Low-temperature braised ox tongue with jungle sour chilli
dishes.zh: 低温卤牛舌佐雨林酸辣酱

tips: Small menu — everything is carefully considered
The fermented olive chicken is the reason to come
Light-luxury setting — suitable for a special dinner without the full fine-dining commitment

restaurants.desc: A standalone villa with a 500 sq metre outdoor lawn in the Haizhu creative park. The wabi-sabi architecture makes every shot composition natural. The hand-crafted brioche and the crayfish claypot rice are the headline dishes.

dishes.zh: 手工布里欧修配自制风味黄油

dishes.en: Charcoal US prime beef short rib 230g
dishes.zh: 炭烤美国极佳级牛小排230g

dishes.en: Lemongrass sauce black tiger prawn ball
Morel and dried fish crayfish claypot rice
dishes.zh: 羊肚菌银鱼腊味煲仔饭

tips: 500 sq metre outdoor lawn — beautiful on a clear evening
The wabi-sabi architecture photographs naturally from every angle
The morel claypot rice takes 25 minutes — order it first

restaurants.zh: 陶醉馆·空中庭院·创意菜
restaurants.address: 海珠区磨碟沙大街118号琶醍B区上三楼
restaurants.desc: A sky courtyard restaurant above the Pearl River Parc beer garden in Haizhu. The private rooms have open-air courtyards and individual tea tables. The hanging clothes peg potato strips dish is the most talked-about creative presentation in the city.

dishes.en: Potato strips hanging on a clothesline
dishes.zh: 挂在晾衣架上的土豆丝

tips: The hanging clothesline potato strips is the most photographed dish in Guangzhou right now
Private rooms have open-air courtyards — request one
Above the Pearl River beer garden — the area is lively at night

restaurants.address: 天河区黄埔大道西81号欢凯酒店二楼
restaurants.desc: A Syrian-decorated industrial interior in Tianhe. The garlic butter baguette and the lemon clam are the most-ordered dishes. An unusually creative space for Guangzhou with concrete walls and vintage television décor.

dishes.en: Tom yum seafood soup soaked rice

tips: Syrian-decorated interior is unique in Guangzhou
The concrete walls and vintage televisions make every corner photogenic
The tom yum soup soaked rice is the most comforting dish on the menu

restaurants.address: 天河区黄埔大道西106号维多利大厦2层A区
restaurants.desc: An all-white French romantic interior housing creative Sichuan-Cantonese fusion. The roast duck with caviar and osmanthus glaze is the signature dish — a combination that sounds improbable and tastes extraordinary.

dishes.en: Roast duck with caviar and osmanthus glaze

tips: The all-white interior photographs beautifully
The caviar duck is the signature — order it regardless of price
The chicken tofu flower soup requires exceptional knife skill — a sign of the kitchen

restaurants.zh: KNOWING明知·创意融合餐酒(天德店)
restaurants.address: 天河区临江大道391号天德广场1座L2层
restaurants.desc: Floor-to-ceiling windows directly facing Canton Tower and Liede Bridge. The Dubai gold Wagyu T-bone and the Pandora Wellington are the theatrical showpieces. The best view-dining experience in Guangzhou at this price point.

dishes.en: Dubai luxury gold Australian M5 T-bone
dishes.zh: 迪拜奢享·鎏金澳洲M5T骨牛排

dishes.en: Pandora magic book Wellington Australian M6 fillet
dishes.zh: 潘多拉魔法书惠灵顿澳洲M6牛柳

The Dubai gold Wagyu is theatrical — the tableside gold leaf application is the performance
One of the best view-to-price ratio dining experiences in Guangzhou

restaurants.zh: 朴食餐厅-创意融合菜(花山小镇店)
restaurants.address: 花都区启源大道花山小镇
restaurants.desc: An 80s heritage building converted into a creative fusion restaurant in Huashan village. The stone-baked ginger chicken and the fried grouper by the jin are the two dishes that bring repeat visitors.

dishes.zh: 擦擦盐煎安格斯牛肉粒

tips: 80s heritage building — beautiful retro setting
About 40 minutes from central Guangzhou — plan accordingly
The stone-baked ginger chicken needs 30 minutes — order it immediately

restaurants.desc: A Korean-influenced creative restaurant on the sixth floor of Grandview Mall. The stinky tofu spicy chicken feet and the tiger cheese fried chicken are the fun crowd-pleasers. Soft, flattering lighting throughout.

dishes.en: Roast fresh pineapple beef short rib

The soft lighting makes food photography very easy
The stinky tofu chicken feet is the surprising crowd-pleaser — order it

restaurants.address: 天河区海明路广粤天地
restaurants.desc: A high-concept Cantonese restaurant in Guangyue Tiandi with ink painting murals and a ceiling-height wine rack. The caviar osmanthus roast duck and the charcoal dry-burned stinky mandarin fish are the theatrical centrepieces.

dishes.zh: 特色炭烤干烧汁臭桂鱼

陈年花雕酒熟醉罗氏虾

In Guangyue Tiandi — a good evening area for a walk after dinner

restaurants.address: 天河区天寿路35号未来社
restaurants.desc: An industrial arts space in the Weilai community with bare concrete walls and rotating art installations. The 14-day dry-aged local farmhouse duck and the mapo Dalian abalone are the most ambitious dishes. Chef sources directly from local farms.

dishes.zh: 黑松露火腿酥皮巴斯克

The 14-day aged duck is the flagship dish — allow 30 minutes
Direct farm sourcing means the menu changes with season

dishes.en: Pomelo peel braised South Africa 18-head dry abalone
dishes.zh: 文旦柚子皮扣南非十八头干鲍

The 18-head dry abalone must be ordered 24 hours in advance
In TIT Creative Park — combine with a walk through the creative district

Book for dinner — the garden looks best in the evening

restaurants.address: 天河区W酒店29楼
restaurants.desc: On the 29th floor of the W Hotel with panoramic city views. The dragon lobster soup taiqi crab and the Australian M5 braised ox cheek are the centrepieces. The tea ceremony component makes this a multi-sensory experience.

dishes.en: Lobster soup taiqi pine needle crab
Australian M5 orange red-braised ox cheek

tips: 29th floor W Hotel panoramic views — go at dusk
The tea ceremony component makes this more than a meal
Book 2 weeks ahead minimum — very limited seating

restaurants.address: 越秀区恤孤院路18号
restaurants.desc: An art museum restaurant in a heritage villa in Dongshan, overseen by non-intangible heritage chef Lan Guijun. The 18-head Yoshihama abalone and the caviar prawn jelly are the signature luxury dishes. One of the most serious dining experiences in southern China.

dishes.zh: 吊晒本色吉品十八头鲍

tips: Book months ahead — extremely limited seating in a heritage villa
Chef Lan Guijun is a non-intangible heritage bearer — this is culinary history
